summary_en: Market leader Yadong (Wuhai) had plant accidents in April and June 2025; restart timing unknown. Price jumps after Qingming and in late June coincided with the two accidents.
raw_text: 今年4月和6月，H酸行业龙头内蒙古乌海亚东精细化工有限公司接连出现工厂事故……从H酸价格走势来看，清明之后与6月底的上涨与两次事故时间节点一致。

summary_en: Effective domestic capacity is below 60,000 t/yr with a supply gap above 10%; Yadong's 20,000 t is over 30% of effective supply.
raw_text: 当前国内H酸有效产能不足6万吨，市场有效供应存在10%以上的缺口。其中，亚东精细化工有限公司的2万吨H酸产能占国内有效供给的30%以上。

summary_en: The March acceleration is linked to the 19 Mar explosion at Liyuan Technology's nitration workshop; Jihua's H-Acid unit was still stopped.
raw_text: 业内普遍认为，3月H酸价格加速上涨与供给端扰动有关，其中内蒙古利元科技硝化车间突发爆炸，涉事产线全面停产且短期内无法复产

summary_en: Baiinfo: industry operating rates stayed low, most producers short of spot material; high caustic soda, sulfuric acid and refined naphthalene prices supported quotes.
raw_text: 此轮价格上涨的核心主因是市场供不应求，目前行业开工持续低迷，整体货源供应十分有限，多数厂家现货紧缺……同时叠加液碱、硫酸、精萘等原料价格高位运行

summary_en: On 28 Jul the Baiinfo average jumped 31% in a day; producer Dachaidan Hexin lifted its ex-works price 64% to ¥100,000. Effective capacity still below 60,000 t with a >10% supply gap.
raw_text: 7月28日，活性染料关键原料H酸行业均价从6.1万元/吨上涨31.15%至8万元/吨……目前我国H酸有效产能已不足6万吨，存在10%以上供给缺口。

summary_en: After the April–May off-season, H-Acid stocks at buyers that purchase it (rather than make it) had fallen to low levels, so the August–September peak-season restocking had to buy expensive spot material.
raw_text: 经历4至5月淡季消耗，外购型厂商H酸及还原物库存已降至低位，后续生产需采购高价现货。

summary_en: Dye makers issued price-increase letters as H-Acid reached ¥130–150k; 2019-era safety rules mean almost no new capacity has been approved.
raw_text: 2019年后H酸新产能批复极少，叠加近年主力装置因整改停产，国内H酸名义产能为8万吨至10万吨，但实际有效产能已不足6万吨
